summary: Tested new features: (1) auto client-confirmation email in addition to team notification, (2) /servicios/sistemas page with 6 aliados, (3) compact SistemasAliados strip inside /servicios hub, (4) header/footer nav entries. Extended /app/backend/tests/test_notify.py to cover confirmacion_enviada + confirmacion_id in Mongo, log line 'Confirmación al cliente enviada', and a new unit test for server.client_email_html (first-name, email, interés, escaped mensaje, '24 horas hábiles', 'o al teléfono' conditional on telefono). Changed the QA POST payload to use Resend's testing address delivered@resend.dev because the Resend account is in test/sandbox mode and rejects arbitrary domains (this was uncovered as an env-only issue: 'Invalid `to` field. Please use our testing email address instead of domains like example.com'). All 8 backend tests pass in 1.95s. Frontend regressions: /servicios/sistemas returns title 'Sistemas y tecnología para tu negocio: reservaciones, boletos, caja, call center y software · Enlace Fintech', H1 exact, 6 cards sistema-0..5 with correct external hrefs (masmesa.com.mx, mastiket.com, infocaja.mx, callmarket.cc, mistramites.mx, acxor.com) all target=_blank, internal links present (sistema-internal-0 → /empresas/restaurantes-y-bares, sistema-internal-4 → /servicios/consultoria-empresarial), sistemas-cta → /contacto, JSON-LD includes Service 'Sistemas y tecnología'. /servicios hub renders sistemas-section with 6 compact cards + sistemas-ver-todos → /servicios/sistemas; the 'También' chips are exactly 2 (Beneficios para colaboradores, Cobros en cripto). Three /servicios/sistemas links appear in the page (header dropdown + footer + breadcrumbs/CTA). /empresas/restaurantes-y-bares MasMesa partner link → https://masmesa.com.mx. Ecosistema block has one link to https://acxor.com. sitemap.xml has 35 <url> entries and includes /servicios/sistemas. Regression: /, /servicios/tarjetas, /blog load with no runtime pageerror. Only 1 real Resend send was consumed (delivered@resend.dev sandbox + team notification email to NOTIFY_EMAILS).
critical_code_review_comments: Resend account is in test/sandbox mode: it rejects `to` addresses whose domain is not verified (e.g., example.com), so notify_client will fail for many real customer submissions with 'Invalid to field'. Before production launch, verify the sending domain in Resend or upgrade the account, otherwise the confirmacion_enviada will remain false for most users while the team notification still works. Consider surfacing this env limitation to the main agent so it can plan a Resend domain-verification/onboarding step.

server.py still has legacy warnings kept from iteration 8: @app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated (migrate to lifespan handlers); logger.basicConfig is defined after functions that reference `logger`. Not blocking but worth cleaning up.
notify_client and notify_team both call resend.Emails.send via asyncio.to_thread with no timeout; a hung Resend call would keep the BackgroundTask alive. Consider asyncio.wait_for(..., timeout=15).
test_credentials: n/a — Resend key in backend/.env, no user auth on this app.
seed_data_creation: 1 QA contact POSTed with email delivered@resend.dev; module-scope autouse fixture deletes docs matching ^QA Test / ^TEST after run. Verified Mongo count returns to baseline.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To re-run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_notify.py -v. Keep contact email as delivered@resend.dev while Resend is in sandbox (otherwise notify_client will fail). Team notification goes to NOTIFY_EMAILS (contacto@enlacefintech.com) and works. Do not exceed 1-2 real POSTs per iteration to preserve Resend quota. All feature acceptance criteria from the review request are met.
